text:
carlos diaz: hi team — i'm coming back from parental leave on 2026-05-04. district just posted intermittent teacher prep days + monthly early-release Wednesdays (few hours). can i use intermittent leave for those, and is there any childcare subsidy for school-closure days?
michelle (People Ops): welcome back soon! yes we allow intermittent family leave for school closures/early-release where you need to handle childcare. two options: 1) swap hours with your manager for that day, or 2) file intermittent FLA (reason: school closure). either is fine. :white_check_mark:
carlos diaz: great. also need a lactation room reservation and permission to use office fridge for milk while i'm back on hybrid schedule. what's the process?
facilities: facilities here — we have dedicated lactation rooms on floors 3 and 7. reserve via this form and we can add a weekly recurring slot: https://intranet.redwood/facilities/lactation-reserve. fridge access: email facilities@ with your name and badge ID and we'll add you to the approved list.
carlos diaz: perfect. do i need to file both the intermittent leave form and the lactation reservation?
michelle (People Ops): yes please file the intermittent leave form for any time-off coding. lactation reservation is separate with facilities. link to leave form: https://intranet.redwood/care/intermittent-leave. include "school closure/early release" in the reason field.
lin a (Benefits): benefits here — for short gaps under 4 hours, employees can use PTO or intermittent FLA. we also have a "backup child care" subsidy program that covers licensed aftercare or emergency camp up to $300/month for up to 3 months for families returning from leave. to request subsidy, choose "returning parent subsidy" in the intermittent leave form and attach invoice/registration.
carlos diaz: is the subsidy taxable? any caps?
lina (Benefits): subsidy is taxable and processed as a reimbursement. cap is $300/month, max 3 months per leave return. provide vendor receipt or registration confirmation. we process within two pay cycles.
carlos diaz: i'm on a mid-year performance review window — will these intermittent days affect my review or equity vesting?
ara (typo)
michelle (People Ops): michelle — we automatically pause review deadlines for employees on approved leave or documented phased returns for up to 60 days. equity vesting continues per grant schedule unless you opt for unpaid leave that affects service months; we'll confirm specifics with Total Rewards if needed. tag Tara for review scheduling.
tara (Manager): Tara here — Carlos, i can accommodate hour swaps and note the review deferral. tag me on the leave form and i'll request a 60-day review hold. also happy to approve recurring hybrid Wednesdays if that helps. :+1:
carlos diaz: payroll coding — want to make sure no miscoding when i use intermittent days + subsidy.
payroll-bot: Payroll note: code intermittent absences as "Intermittent FLA - School Closure" (paid/unpaid per employee election) or PTO if used. Subsidy reimbursed as "Childcare Subsidy Reimbursement" (taxable). Submit forms before payroll cutoff to ensure correct cycle.
carlos diaz: last q — i pump at work, do we need a medical accommodation form or is lactation covered automatically?
michelle (People Ops): lactation is treated as a standard accommodation under state laws; no medical cert required. if you need private schedule adjustments beyond standard breaks, file the accommodation form so we have it on file. link: https://intranet.redwood/care/accommodations
carlos diaz: thanks all. i'll submit intermittent leave entries for the announced early-release days, reserve lactation room, and request the returning-parent subsidy. will tag Tara. :pray:
